####################################################################################################
Purpose of script: Simulate SE2I2R model with seasonal vaccine protection
####################################################################################################

# Setup
```{r setup, include=FALSE}
rm(list = ls())
# Packages
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(glue)
library(lubridate)
library(patchwork)
library(pomp)

source("fun_createSE2I2Rmod.R")
theme_set(theme_classic())
```

# Function to reformat simulations
```{r}
fun_reformatsimulations <- function(sims_wide, delta_t = delta_t) {
  # Args: 
  # sims_wide: simulations in wide format (data frame)
  # Returns: simulations in long format, with year and week no added
  
  sims_long <- sims_wide %>% 
    mutate(E = E1 + E2, 
           I = I1 + I2, 
           week = (time - delta_t / 2) %% 52 + delta_t / 2,
           year = (time - delta_t / 2) %/% 52 + 1) %>% 
    select(time, everything(), -c("E1", "E2", "I1", "I2")) %>% 
    pivot_longer(cols = -c(.id, time, year, week), 
                 names_to = "state_var", 
                 values_to = "val")
  
  # Check that all years and weeks appear the same no of time 
  stopifnot(length(unique(table(sims_long$year))) == 1)
  
  return(sims_long)
}
```

# Define a location
```{r}
# Tropical = SKBO, Colombia
# Temperate = Rostock, Germany 
loc = "SKBO"
```

# Seasonal transmission ============================================================================
```{r}
# Climate data
dat_clim <- readRDS(glue("covars_{loc}.rds")) %>%
  group_by(week = week(week_date)) %>%
  summarise(Te = mean(Te, na.rm = TRUE),
            RH_pred = mean(RH_pred, na.rm = TRUE))

# Plot climate data
dat_clim %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(Te, RH_pred)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = week, y = value)) +
  geom_line() +
  facet_grid(name~., scales = "free")

# School terms (only for Colombia)
if(loc == "SKBO") {
dat_school <- readRDS("data_school_calendar.rds") %>%
  filter(country == "colombia") %>%
  mutate(school = case_when(school == 0 ~ -1, .default = school)) 

# Plot data school calendar (only for Colombia)
ggplot(dat_school, 
       aes(x = as.numeric(week), y = school, color = country)) + 
  geom_line() + 
  geom_point()
}
```

# Seasonal vaccine protection ======================================================================

```{r}
coef_cosine_l <- readRDS("../outputs/modres_coef_cosine.rds")
coef_cosine_l %>%
  filter(pathogen == "vzv")
omega <- 2.0 * pi / 52.0

# Plot it
filter(coef_cosine_l, pathogen == "vzv", str_detect(mod, "cs.rds|csi_reg_3")) %>%
  uncount(weights = 52) %>%
  group_by(pathogen, mod, reg, clu) %>%
  mutate(week = row_number(),
         prot = (amp*cos((omega * week) - ((phi) * omega))),
         wain = (amp*cos((omega * week) - ((phi+(52/2)) * omega)))) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = week, y = prot, color = clu)) + 
  geom_line() + 
  geom_line(aes(y = wain), alpha = 0.3) + 
  geom_vline(aes(xintercept = phi, color = clu), linetype = "dotted") + 
  geom_vline(aes(xintercept = phi+(52/2), color = clu), linetype = "dotted") + 
  geom_hline(aes(yintercept = amp, color = clu), linetype = "dotted") + 
  scale_y_continuous("Protection") + 
  scale_x_continuous("Week") + 
  scale_color_manual(values = c("dodgerblue", "orange"), na.value = "grey20") + 
  facet_grid(~clu) + 
  theme(legend.position = "top",
        strip.background = element_blank())

# Select coefficients according to the location
prot_coef <- if(loc == "SKBO") {
  filter(coef_cosine_l, pathogen == "vzv", reg == "reg_4", clu == "2_Tropical")
} else if (loc == "Rostock") {
  filter(coef_cosine_l, pathogen == "vzv", reg == "reg_4", clu == "1_Temperate")
}
```
# Simulations ======================================================================================

# Parameters
```{r}
parms <- c(
  "mu" = 1 / 80 / 52, # Birth/death rate
  "R0" = 10, # Basic reproduction no
  "sigma" = 7 / 14, # 1 / average latent period
  "gamma" = 7 / 7, # 1 / average infectious period
  "amp_term" = 0, # amplitude of term-time forcing
  "e_RH" = -0.2, # effect of relative humidity
  "e_Te" = -0.2, # effect of temperature 
  "p_V" = 0.80, # coverage (probability to get vaccinated)
  "prot0" = 0, # average vaccine protection
  "amp_prot" = prot_coef$amp, # amplitude of seasonal vaccine protection
  "phi_prot" = prot_coef$phi # phase of seasonal vaccine protection
)
```

# Simulate just 1 
```{r}
# 1. Prepare covars 
covars <- data.frame(week = rep(1:52, 200), time = 1:(52*200)) %>%
  left_join(dat_clim)  

# 2. Create pomp object and make basic checks
mod <- fun_createSE2I2Rmod(n_years = 1000, country_name = "Colombia", covars = covars, debug_bool = F)

# 3. Run 1 simulation
coef(mod)[names(parms)] <- parms
tj <- trajectory(object = mod, format = "data.frame")
stopifnot(round(rowSums(select(tj, c("V", "S", "E1", "E2", "I1", "I2", "R"))), digits = 3) == 1)
fun_reformatsimulations(tj, delta_t = 0.1) %>%
  mutate(state_var = factor(state_var, levels = c("V", "S", "E", "I", "R", "CC"))) %>%
  filter(year > 190) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = time/52, y = val)) + 
  geom_line() + 
  facet_grid(state_var~., scales = "free")
```

# Simulate with different parameters
```{r}
# 4. Run different simulations 
# Define grid of parameters to change
chg_parms <- expand.grid(
  prot0 = c(0, 0.70, 0.95),
  amp_prot = prot_coef$amp * c(0, 0.5, 1, 2),
  phi_prot = prot_coef$phi + c(0, 13, 26, 39), 
  amp_term = c(0)) %>% 
  mutate(.id = as.character(seq_len(nrow(.))))

# Create mat of parameters with changes 
p_mat <- parmat(params = coef(mod), nrep = nrow(chg_parms))
p_mat["prot0", ] <- chg_parms$prot0
p_mat["amp_prot", ] <- chg_parms$amp_prot
p_mat["phi_prot", ] <- chg_parms$phi_prot
p_mat["amp_term", ] <- chg_parms$amp_term

tjm <- trajectory(object = mod, format = "data.frame", method = "lsoda", params = p_mat)

tjm_long <- tjm %>%
  mutate(N = round(V + S + E1 + E2 + I1 + I2 + R, digits = 3),
         VR = R+V) %>%
  fun_reformatsimulations(delta_t = 0.1) %>%
  filter(year > 195) %>%
  left_join(chg_parms) 

# Exact seasonal protection parameters:
tjm_long %>%
  filter(phi_prot == prot_coef$phi, amp_prot == prot_coef$amp, amp_term == 0) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = time/52, y = val, color = as.factor(prot0), group = prot0)) + 
  geom_line() + 
  facet_wrap(state_var~., scales = "free", ncol = 1)

# Changing the seasonal protection parameters:
tjm_long %>%
  filter(prot0 == 0.70, amp_term == 0) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = time/52, y = val, color = amp_prot, group = amp_prot)) + 
  geom_line() + 
  scale_colour_viridis_c() + 
  facet_wrap(state_var~as.factor(phi_prot), scales = "free", ncol = 4)

# Adding school terms
tjm_long %>%
  filter(prot0 == 0.70, phi_prot == prot_coef$phi) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = time/52, y = val, color = amp_prot, group = amp_prot)) + 
  geom_line() + 
  scale_colour_viridis_c() + 
  facet_wrap(state_var~amp_term, scales = "free", ncol = 2)
```

# Checking changes in phi and amp
```{r}
expand.grid(week = 1:52,
            amp = prot_coef$amp * c(0.5, 1, 2),
            phi = prot_coef$phi + c(13, 26, 39, 52)) %>%
  mutate(prot = amp*cos((omega * week) - (phi * omega)),
         amp_phi = glue("{amp}_{phi}")) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = week, y = prot, group = amp_phi, color = as.factor(round(amp, digits = 2)))) + 
  geom_line() + 
  facet_grid(~round(phi)) +
  scale_color_viridis_d("Amplitude") + 
  theme(legend.position = "top")
```
